features.name: xBomb Wild Multipliers
features.description: Clear neighbours and raise the multiplier.

review:
A 6x6 mining sequel. Each spin starts with three active rows, and every collapse opens another, up to six. Dirt blocks hide wilds, split symbols or bonus symbols that only activate once the dirt is cleared.

xBomb wilds clear nearby symbols and raise the multiplier, and Wild Mining returns from the original. A slow build that can end in huge cascades. Insane volatility, 65,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
